review_level: single-pass source-grounded annotation; no independent second annotator

tables.1: Dataset statistics captured in dataset metadata, not evaluation outcomes
tables.2: 18 accuracies, six absolute gains, one macro-mean absolute gain
tables.3–12: training formats and prompt templates; no quantitative experimental outcome cells

figures.1–8,10–11: All curve vertices, explicit labels, baseline legends and available confidence-band endpoints; fitted lines represented by printed parameters rather than inventing extra sampled observations
figures.9: All 16 heatmap cells with six symmetric repeats and three textual inequality bounds

other_numbers: Headline gains, setting counts and repeats; compute/time estimates; four cited numerical accuracy results. Training parameters, data counts and decoding parameters in entity metadata. Bibliography numbers, equation constants, prompt numbering are not outcome rows. No independent second annotator claimed.
scope_notes: Paper compares parametric training against measured RAG and combines training with RAG, so it is in scope despite title Beyond RAG. Supporting diversity and gradient outcomes retained with separate tasks/metric groups.
